title: Thirteen Winters and One Short Fence
subtitle: 生态保护 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 生态保护（人与自然·环境保护与可持续发展）
meta: 主题语境：生态保护（人与自然·环境保护与可持续发展）　|　核心词汇：extinction　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 extinction 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 my aunt ① faced an extinction that no keeper in the reserve would have named, and she said the facing was the whole of the winter. The ② extinction, meaning the loss itself and not the count, ran thirteen winters and stayed unnamed in the book; an extinction, she said, is the only thing in a reserve that is judged by how long it is left unnamed.

Every ③ extinction in that reserve had the same short fence beside it, and the ④ extinction at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the birds and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An extinction, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to name; my aunt said the naming is the part that fills thirteen winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the extinction was the whole of the warning, meaning the ending and not the loss. The ⑥ extinction, meaning the ending and not any of that, is the only thing in a warning that everybody waits for and nobody names; extinction, he said, is either something you face or the only word that means both a loss and an ending. He said the ending is the part they remember.

By 1996 the ⑦ extinction had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short fence. The ⑧ extinction of the whole thing, my aunt wrote in January, was one reserve and thirteen winters of naming; extinction, she said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to name. She said the naming was never mentioned.

The ⑨ extinction I remember is the one named in the report, which closed in 2001 and is still described as the quietest in the reserve. An ⑩ extinction, my mother said in 2003, is the only one that improves by being named; every extinction, she said, is an ending that has agreed to look like a loss. She said the ending was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 灭绝；消亡（指保护区里每一次旁边的那一次）
B. n. 灭绝（指那一次消失本身，与统计数字相对）
C. 固定搭配：face an extinction 面对一次灭绝
D. n. 灭绝（指留给鸟类的那一次）
E. n. 灭绝（抽象总称，指一处保护区的灭绝之事）
F. n. 灭绝（指报告上写到、被命名的那一次）
G. n. 终结；消亡（指一次警告里人人都等却无人命名的那样东西）
H. n. 终结（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人命名的那样东西）

answers.why: face an extinction 意为“面对一次灭绝”，1988 年姑姑面对了一次保护区里没有一位管理员肯命名的灭绝。
extinction 意为“灭绝”，指那一次消失本身而不是统计数字，它经过了十三个冬天而在簿子上没有名字。
extinction 意为“灭绝”，指保护区里每一次旁边的那一次，每一次旁边都有同一道短短的围栏。
extinction 意为“灭绝”，指留给鸟类的那一次，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
extinction 意为“终结、消亡”，指一次警告里人人都等却无人命名的那样东西，叔叔说这次终结就是那份警告的全部。
extinction 意为“终结”，指人人都等却无人命名的那样东西而不是那一次消失，是警告里人人都等、却无人命名的东西。
extinction 意为“灭绝”，指报告上写到、被命名的那一次，到 1996 年这一次成了报告里的一行。
extinction 意为“灭绝”，姑姑一月写道，整件事的灭绝之事是一处保护区和十三个冬天的命名。
extinction 意为“灭绝”，我记得的是报告上命名的那一次，2001 年结束了，至今仍被说成保护区里最安静的一次。
extinction 为抽象总称，母亲 2003 年说，一次灭绝是唯一会因为被好好命名而变得更好的东西。
